items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 77:1
items.html: For the Nukva of the first coupling of Aba and Ima is the VAK of Hochma of BON, and she is much greater than the male, who is only Keter and Hochma of the level of Bina of MA. For the phase of Hochma is very high above the phase of Bina, as is known. Hence the Nukva of the first coupling does not receive her sufficiency from the male according to her need, and therefore she is entirely included in the male, who is the Yod of the name HaVaYaH, and she does not rise to be independent in the name. (Inner Light, page 806, Sub Header, “Now”)
